relations.subject: Noa Ronkin
relations.evidence: This book is a revised version of my doctoral dissertation, ‘A Metaphysics of Experience: from the Buddha’s Teaching to the Abhidhamma’ that was submitted to the Faculty of Oriental Studies at the University of Oxford in spring 2003.

relations.subject: Noa Ronkin
relations.evidence: My foremost gratitude and respect are extended to Richard Gombrich, who supervised my D.Phil. and has been an invaluable source of insight and encouragement.

relations.subject: Noa Ronkin
